head_commit.message:
docs(pairing): relabel archived-pair amplitudes as archived, and guard the vocabulary that F26 left behind (F33)

F26 changed the live pairing (f_H 0.297 -> 0.7501856343179664, re-paired raw
amplitudes) but the documentation kept calling the archived amplitudes canonical.
The sentence 'the canonical anchor sigma/m = 174 cm^2/g @ 29.4 km/s' was still on
CURRENT.md, README.md, EXTRACT.md and the v19.2-E report of record, and 86
paragraphs across nine live-facing documents quoted archived-pair amplitudes with
no pairing label. After F26, 174 cm^2/g is an archived-pair raw amplitude; the live
canonical raw peak is 27.272481773080454 cm^2/g, and both give the same halo-level
sigma_eff = 15.348366 cm^2/g.

This is a relabel, not a number change: every amplitude, every effective prediction
and every artifact is untouched.

- scripts/drift_guard.py: check_archived_pair_labels() + check_pairing_declaration().
  A canonical/current paragraph must label each archived amplitude within 160 chars;
  a paragraph quoting both an archived and a live-pair amplitude is a pairing claim
  even with the word 'canonical' deleted; a document may declare a default pairing but
  the declaration is verified against the canonical artifact and never excuses a
  paragraph that says 'canonical anchor'; fenced formulas are never edited internally
  but must carry the declaration on the sentence that introduces them; a literal counts
  as an amplitude only when sigma/f_H/peak-adjacent with an assignment or a cm^2/g unit,
  so a '174 passed' test tally is not read as an amplitude. Wired into --strict for
  README, CURRENT, EXTRACT, LAYMAN_SUMMARY, the paper, the v19.2-E report, the reference
  data registry, the findings and citation docs.
- Front pages and the report of record now state the live pairing and label the archived
  amplitude in the shared anchor sentence.
- Paper: pairing declaration at the top, local '(archived pair)' labels at claim sites,
  and the §3.3 canonical table headings now name the pairing they print.
- v0.3-prelim/tests/test_pairing_label_coverage.py: 9 tests, including negative ones
  (strip a label -> guard fires; strip a formula declaration -> guard fires; prose tally
  -> guard stays silent) and a check that 174 still exists as the archived value.
- F33 documented in docs/INTEGRITY_FINDINGS_2026-11-04.md and
  docs/FINDINGS_FOR_FUTURE_DELIBERATION.md 27.15, CURRENT.md and CHANGELOG.md.

workflow_runs.display_title: fix(audit): make layer 10 check pairing claims at their claim sites

head_commit.message:
fix(audit): make layer 10 check pairing claims at their claim sites

The mutation harness proved the hole: corrupting the abstract's live-pair
bound left the A.3 copy, and links 4/6 only ask whether a recomputed value
appears somewhere in the paper, so layer 10 stayed green (mutation_run4.txt,
11/14 caught). Two further "misses" were the harness miscounting a guard
that fired inside a pytest fixture as a non-catch.

Layer 10 now scans six anchored pairing-labelled claim slices and demands
that every scientific-notation quantity printed inside a claim equals a
recomputed value at the precision printed; a missing claim anchor is a
failure. Extra anchors were added to both chains (Option B ratio/bound,
sigma_1 = 3.0, sigma_1 = 4.4), each loosening by sqrt(1/K) = 2.5258775566261495.
Artifact: 35 checks, 0 failures.

The scan's first run caught two defects in the paper:
- the two pairings' sigma_eff agreement was claimed "to within 1.9e-16";
  the recomputed maximum relative residual is 1.3e-17 (1.9e-16 was the
  artifact-wide absolute worst case from the F26 re-pairing diff),
- the archived resonance-peak ratio was printed 3.30e25 where
  sigma_peak x m_chi / sigma_SI = 3.2948936170e25 -> 3.29e25.

Guards: v0.3-prelim/tests/test_hierarchy_chain_pairing.py (14 passed), five of
them link-7 tests including a refusal of a paper that stops labelling its
pairing claims. Harness v4: 16/16 caught, 10 files restored byte-identically,
baseline 28/28. Full suite 3630 passed / 26 skipped / 3 warnings. Strict drift,
fabrication, pairing registry and T82 (120/120) clean. Documented as finding
F31 with deliberation 27.13, including the disclosure that the documentation
helper itself dropped a neighbouring bullet's text before commit.
